source_text: And what, may I ask, are you doing in the Boneyards?

text: 你能说说你在晒骨场干什么吗？
source_text: 你能说说你在晒骨场干什么吗？

text: 你的问题很多啊。
source_text: 你的问题很多啊。

source_text: First you tell me who you are.

text: 你先告诉我你是谁。
source_text: 你先告诉我你是谁。

text: I'm just an explorer.
source_text: I'm just an explorer.

text: 我只是一个闲逛的人。
source_text: 我只是一个闲逛的人。

text: I'm looking for a replacement water chip for my Vault.
source_text: I'm looking for a replacement water chip for my Vault.

text: 我想为我的避难所找到净水芯片。
source_text: 我想为我的避难所找到净水芯片。

text: You learn to be careful out here. So what are you doing here?
source_text: You learn to be careful out here. So what are you doing here?

text: 你在这里要小心点。你是干什么的？
source_text: 你在这里要小心点。你是干什么的？

text: All right, fair enough. I'm called Katja. What's it matter to you?
source_text: All right, fair enough. I'm called Katja. What's it matter to you?

text: 好啦，为了公平，我叫卡佳，你为什么要知道？
source_text: 好啦，为了公平，我叫卡佳，你为什么要知道？

text: Why so hostile?
source_text: Why so hostile?

text: 这么敌意做什么？
source_text: 这么敌意做什么？

text: Hey, if you're going to be rude about it, then I'll see you later.
source_text: Hey, if you're going to be rude about it, then I'll see you later.

text: 你再这么粗暴，我可走了。
source_text: 你再这么粗暴，我可走了。

text: I'm looking for information. Can you help?
source_text: I'm looking for information. Can you help?

text: 我想打听点消息，你能帮我吗？
source_text: 我想打听点消息，你能帮我吗？

text: You might, but you're on my home turf, not vice-versa. So put up or# shut up.

You might, but you're on my home turf, not vice-versa. So put up or
# shut up.

text: 随你，你在我的地盘上，而不是我在你的地盘上，所以要么说实话，要么就闭嘴。
source_text: 随你，你在我的地盘上，而不是我在你的地盘上，所以要么说实话，要么就闭嘴。

text: It's not important, I'm just a traveler. I need some information.
source_text: It's not important, I'm just a traveler. I need some information.

text: 我是谁不重要。我只是一个旅行者，我需要情报。
source_text: 我是谁不重要。我只是一个旅行者，我需要情报。

text: A water purification chip? Sorry, don't know anything about that. Don't# see much of that kind of tech here in the Boneyards, except maybe the stuff# Miles works on.
source_text:
A water purification chip? Sorry, don't know anything about that. Don't
# see much of that kind of tech here in the Boneyards, except maybe the stuff
# Miles works on.

text: 净水芯片？抱歉，我一点都不知道。晒骨场没有什么高科技，除了麦尔斯，他经常捣腾一些高级货。
source_text: 净水芯片？抱歉，我一点都不知道。晒骨场没有什么高科技，除了麦尔斯，他经常捣腾一些高级货。

text: Well, thanks anyhow.
source_text: Well, thanks anyhow.

text: 哦，谢谢。
source_text: 哦，谢谢。

text: Miles? Where can I find him, and could he help?
source_text: Miles? Where can I find him, and could he help?

text: 麦尔斯？我怎么找到他？他会帮我吗？
source_text: 麦尔斯？我怎么找到他？他会帮我吗？

text: Can you tell me more about the Boneyards, then?
source_text: Can you tell me more about the Boneyards, then?

text: 那你再和我说说晒骨场的事情吧。
source_text: 那你再和我说说晒骨场的事情吧。

text: Just a traveler. I've heard that one before. Nobody comes to the# Boneyard except those Hub merchants and people looking for a quick death at the# hands of the gangs. What are you really here for?
source_text:
Just a traveler. I've heard that one before. Nobody comes to the
# Boneyard except those Hub merchants and people looking for a quick death at the
# hands of the gangs. What are you really here for?

text: 只是一个旅行者？这种话我也听过不少了。除了来混黑道想死得快的人和哈勃城的商人，没人愿意来晒骨场。你到底是来做什么的？
source_text: 只是一个旅行者？这种话我也听过不少了。除了来混黑道想死得快的人和哈勃城的商人，没人愿意来晒骨场。你到底是来做什么的？

text: You're right. I'm looking for a water purification chip.
source_text: You're right. I'm looking for a water purification chip.

text: 你说的不错，我是来找净水芯片的。
source_text: 你说的不错，我是来找净水芯片的。

text: I don't need to tell you anything.
source_text: I don't need to tell you anything.

text: 我无可奉告。
source_text: 我无可奉告。

text: Damn straight. But that's a two-way street.
source_text: Damn straight. But that's a two-way street.

text: 太对了，我来去这里不必你管吧。
source_text: 太对了，我来去这里不必你管吧。

text: Maybe. You definitely aren't one of those gangland shiv-shovers. What# do you want?
source_text:
Maybe. You definitely aren't one of those gangland shiv-shovers. What
# do you want?

text: 也许吧，你显然不是那些地痞小混混的样子，你想做什么？
source_text: 也许吧，你显然不是那些地痞小混混的样子，你想做什么？

text: I'm looking for a water purification chip.
source_text: I'm looking for a water purification chip.

text: 我在找净水芯片。
source_text: 我在找净水芯片。

text: I need more information about the Boneyard.
source_text: I need more information about the Boneyard.

text: 我还想知道些晒骨场的事情。
source_text: 我还想知道些晒骨场的事情。

text: I need to know about the area around this city.
source_text: I need to know about the area around this city.

text: 我想打听城里的一些地方。
source_text: 我想打听城里的一些地方。

text: What can you tell me about the Blades?
source_text: What can you tell me about the Blades?

text: 你能和我说说利刃帮吗？
source_text: 你能和我说说利刃帮吗？

text: What can you tell me about the Rippers?
source_text: What can you tell me about the Rippers?

text: 你能说说电锯党吗？
source_text: 你能说说电锯党吗？

text: What can you tell me about the Gun Runners?
source_text: What can you tell me about the Gun Runners?

text: 你能和我说说军火商的事情吗？
source_text: 你能和我说说军火商的事情吗？

text: What can you tell me about the Followers?
source_text: What can you tell me about the Followers?

text: 你能说说那些末世论者的事情吗？
source_text: 你能说说那些末世论者的事情吗？

text: What can you tell me about Adytum?
source_text: What can you tell me about Adytum?

text: 你能说说内城区的事情吗？
source_text: 你能说说内城区的事情吗？

text: Well, it was nice chatting. Gotta go.
source_text: Well, it was nice chatting. Gotta go.

text: 和你聊的很愉快，再见。
source_text: 和你聊的很愉快，再见。

text: Miles lives in Adytum. He's a scientist, mostly working with chemistry.# If anyone could scrounge up a water chip or make a replacement, it would be him.
source_text:
Miles lives in Adytum. He's a scientist, mostly working with chemistry.
# If anyone could scrounge up a water chip or make a replacement, it would be him.

text: 麦尔斯住在内城区，他是个化学家。如果城里有人能制造净水芯片，那只有他了。
source_text: 麦尔斯住在内城区，他是个化学家。如果城里有人能制造净水芯片，那只有他了。

text: Thanks very much.
source_text: Thanks very much.

text: 太感谢了。
source_text: 太感谢了。

text: Adytum is my original home. A little too boring for me, though. It's a# fenced-off and self-sufficient town in the south end of the Boneyard, but not as# far as the Cathedral. We trade sometimes with the Hub.
source_text:
Adytum is my original home. A little too boring for me, though. It's a
# fenced-off and self-sufficient town in the south end of the Boneyard, but not as
# far as the Cathedral. We trade sometimes with the Hub.

text: 内城区是我的老家，虽然有点闷。但是自我隔绝，自给自足，它在晒骨场的南区，但是要在大教堂北边一点。我们也和哈勃城做些买卖。
source_text: 内城区是我的老家，虽然有点闷。但是自我隔绝，自给自足，它在晒骨场的南区，但是要在大教堂北边一点。我们也和哈勃城做些买卖。

text: I've dealt with them before. They're not too bad, as far as gangs go.# They have a hide-out in an old club, with some outposts. If you're careful you# might even be able to get some of them to talk.
source_text:
I've dealt with them before. They're not too bad, as far as gangs go.
# They have a hide-out in an old club, with some outposts. If you're careful you
# might even be able to get some of them to talk.

text: 我和他们打过交道。做为一个帮派，他们还不算太坏。他们的总坛在一个旧的夜总会，周围哨所不少。如果你当心点，也许还能和他们说上话。
source_text: 我和他们打过交道。做为一个帮派，他们还不算太坏。他们的总坛在一个旧的夜总会，周围哨所不少。如果你当心点，也许还能和他们说上话。

text: The Rippers are just plain ferocious. They're an inbred bunch that# delights in torture and murder. I stay away from them, and you should, too.# They actually put fuckin' land mines around their fortress.
source_text:
The Rippers are just plain ferocious. They're an inbred bunch that
# delights in torture and murder. I stay away from them, and you should, too.
# They actually put fuckin' land mines around their fortress.

text: 电锯党就是一群没人性的禽兽。他们天生就是一帮子杀人狂虐待狂。我尽量离他们远一点，你也最好别惹他们。他们居然还在总部周围布上了可恶的地雷。
source_text: 电锯党就是一群没人性的禽兽。他们天生就是一帮子杀人狂虐待狂。我尽量离他们远一点，你也最好别惹他们。他们居然还在总部周围布上了可恶的地雷。

text: The Gun Runners used to be a real gang, but they went soft. They started# setting up a deal where they trade weapons that they get from their victims or buy# from the Hub. Since nobody here is up for the trip to the Hub personally, they do# pretty good business, even though their prices are high.
source_text:
The Gun Runners used to be a real gang, but they went soft. They started
# setting up a deal where they trade weapons that they get from their victims or buy
# from the Hub. Since nobody here is up for the trip to the Hub personally, they do
# pretty good business, even though their prices are high.

text: 军火商以前也是一个黑帮，后来洗手不干了。他们用抢来的或者是从哈勃买来的枪械作买卖。这里没人愿意自己单独去哈勃城，所以他们的货很抢手，就是价格高了点。
source_text: 军火商以前也是一个黑帮，后来洗手不干了。他们用抢来的或者是从哈勃买来的枪械作买卖。这里没人愿意自己单独去哈勃城，所以他们的货很抢手，就是价格高了点。

text: The Followers of the Apocalypse are a group of peace-preachers who live in# a large library near the heart of the Boneyard. Why they haven't been wiped out# yet I can't say. They are lousy combatants and have no understanding of the real# world, but other than that they are polite and well-educated.
source_text:
The Followers of the Apocalypse are a group of peace-preachers who live in
# a large library near the heart of the Boneyard. Why they haven't been wiped out
# yet I can't say. They are lousy combatants and have no understanding of the real
# world, but other than that they are polite and well-educated.

text: 末世论者是一帮和平主义者，他们住在晒骨场中心区的一所大图书馆里。我也说不上为什么一直没有帮派会去铲除他们。他们是无畏的战士，对现实社会没有认同。但是除此之外，他们还算友好，比较有教养。
source_text: 末世论者是一帮和平主义者，他们住在晒骨场中心区的一所大图书馆里。我也说不上为什么一直没有帮派会去铲除他们。他们是无畏的战士，对现实社会没有认同。但是除此之外，他们还算友好，比较有教养。

text: The Boneyard is a pretty hostile place. I've never had the opportunity to# leave, though I suppose I'd take it. Let's see . . . just south of here you have# the Cathedral. There's some sort of cult there, but I stay away from them.# Something sinister is going on there. Also, I've heard about the trading center# called the Hub, and caravans occasionally show up, but I've never been there.
source_text:
The Boneyard is a pretty hostile place. I've never had the opportunity to
# leave, though I suppose I'd take it. Let's see . . . just south of here you have
# the Cathedral. There's some sort of cult there, but I stay away from them.
# Something sinister is going on there. Also, I've heard about the trading center
# called the Hub, and caravans occasionally show up, but I've never been there.

text: 晒骨场是一个充满敌意的地方。我一直没有机会离开这里，大概以后会有机会吧。嗯……再往南走就是大教堂了。那里有一群教众总在祭拜什么，我宁可离他们远一点。而且我觉得那里不干净，不吉利。我还知道贸易中心哈勃城，经常有那里的商队来这里，但我从来没去过哈勃城。
source_text: 晒骨场是一个充满敌意的地方。我一直没有机会离开这里，大概以后会有机会吧。嗯……再往南走就是大教堂了。那里有一群教众总在祭拜什么，我宁可离他们远一点。而且我觉得那里不干净，不吉利。我还知道贸易中心哈勃城，经常有那里的商队来这里，但我从来没去过哈勃城。

text: I don't plan to stay in this place too much longer, myself.
source_text: I don't plan to stay in this place too much longer, myself.

text: 我也不打算一个人在这个城市长呆。
source_text: 我也不打算一个人在这个城市长呆。

text: Thanks for the information.
source_text: Thanks for the information.

text: 谢谢你的信息。
source_text: 谢谢你的信息。

text: Can you tell me some more?
source_text: Can you tell me some more?

text: 你还知道些什么？
source_text: 你还知道些什么？

text: No kidding. If you're looking for another hand, I'll sign on. Better than# spending the rest of my existence in this hellhole, right?
source_text:
No kidding. If you're looking for another hand, I'll sign on. Better than
# spending the rest of my existence in this hellhole, right?

text: 说实话，如果你需要一个帮手，我怎么样？至少我不用在这里继续鬼混下去了，如何？
source_text: 说实话，如果你需要一个帮手，我怎么样？至少我不用在这里继续鬼混下去了，如何？

text: You're a welcome addition, but the desert's not much more fun.
source_text: You're a welcome addition, but the desert's not much more fun.

text: 我很欢迎你，但是荒漠里可没有什么好玩的。
source_text: 我很欢迎你，但是荒漠里可没有什么好玩的。

text: Don't worry about it. Thanks anyhow.
source_text: Don't worry about it. Thanks anyhow.

text: 你不用操这个心了，多谢。
source_text: 你不用操这个心了，多谢。

text: Can I ask some more questions first?
source_text: Can I ask some more questions first?

text: 那我能先问几个问题吗？
source_text: 那我能先问几个问题吗？

text: This area's overrun with the three gangs - the Blades, Rippers, and Gun# Runners - as well as serving as home for the Followers and for my own home,# Adytum.
source_text:
This area's overrun with the three gangs - the Blades, Rippers, and Gun
# Runners - as well as serving as home for the Followers and for my own home,
# Adytum.

text: 这个地区有三大帮派－－利刃帮，电锯党和军火商－－还有末世论者以及我的老家内城区。
source_text: 这个地区有三大帮派－－利刃帮，电锯党和军火商－－还有末世论者以及我的老家内城区。

text: All right, looks like we've got a little ass-kicking to do!
source_text: All right, looks like we've got a little ass-kicking to do!

text: 很好，似乎有不少烂人可以消遣呢。
source_text: 很好，似乎有不少烂人可以消遣呢。

text: Look, 90% of the people in this city fall into one or more of three# categories - rapists, murderers, or thieves. I'm a thief and you actually seem# polite, so that makes me wonder, okay? Call it a survival instinct.
source_text:
Look, 90% of the people in this city fall into one or more of three
# categories - rapists, murderers, or thieves. I'm a thief and you actually seem
# polite, so that makes me wonder, okay? Call it a survival instinct.

text: 要知道，城里百分之九十的人都逃不了这三种：色情狂、杀人犯和小偷，有些人还是不止一样。我是个小偷，你还算比较客气，所以我才会有些想法，明白？这叫做生存直觉。
source_text: 要知道，城里百分之九十的人都逃不了这三种：色情狂、杀人犯和小偷，有些人还是不止一样。我是个小偷，你还算比较客气，所以我才会有些想法，明白？这叫做生存直觉。

text: Sorry to step on your feet then. I guess I'll just go the hell away.
source_text: Sorry to step on your feet then. I guess I'll just go the hell away.

source_text: 那我还能再问几个小小的问题吗？

text: Nothing yet. But stay tuned.

text: 没事，小心点。

text: You again? What're you back for now?

text: 又是你？你还要做什么？
